                    <b>Instancing</b> lets you draw the same mesh many times in one go. Problems with the naive approach: One draw command per object. Huge CPU overhead. Underuses GPU parallelism. Benefits of <b>instancing</b>: A single draw command produces many objects. Efficient use of GPU memory. Each instance can have its own data.
